title: I built an arcade inside ChatGPT
author: rectangle_so
selftext:

You can pick a game and start playing right in the conversation. Play solo or invite friends, on your phone or desktop its that simple.   
  
Free to play. Play together anywhere.  
  
Install the EggVerse in ChatGPT as a plugin or play at [**eggverse.co**](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=http%3A%2F%2Feggverse%2Eco&urlhash=q-GK&mt=R7Rf2pC24bmpxHcTxrM8QE1Js6K_ykSSXo4au05Rn-a3E3u82MEadnii2u6zIbL_pLyuNdDgarji1-U_brq2mTdgnLsYnV9KO9qLIKpj7vZlxDnV2i9rp5d14Ir0fxk1WVnkiEQurrE_zVTl_d5sUC4243ns2Yr1RRN3x_0EhOGQcivyq4PXEM08kQxTGhJvuw&isSdui=true)

But now with the self-promo out of the way, what do you use to edit videos?
